title: Colossians Bible Quiz - Chapter 4
description: Ten questions on Colossians 4: steadfast prayer, speech seasoned with salt, and the greetings that close the letter.

questions.text: What does verse 1 tell masters to give their servants, and why?
questions.explanation: Verse 1 tells masters to give their servants that which is just and equal, knowing that they also have a Master in heaven.

answers.text: Rest on the Sabbath day, because the law requires it
Their freedom, because there is no partiality
That which is just and equal, because they also have a Master in heaven
A share of the inheritance, because they are brothers

questions.text: How does verse 2 tell them to continue in prayer?
questions.explanation: Verse 2 says "Continue steadfastly in prayer, watching in it with thanksgiving."

answers.text: Steadfastly, watching in it with thanksgiving
Quietly, each one alone in his own house
Daily, at the appointed hours of prayer
Boldly, with fasting and with much weeping

questions.text: What does he ask them to pray that God may open?
questions.explanation: Verse 3 asks them to pray that God may open a door for the word, to speak the mystery of Christ, for which he is also in bonds.

answers.text: The eyes of the Gentiles
The prison where he is held
The hearts of the Laodiceans
A door for the word

questions.text: How does verse 6 say their speech should always be?
questions.explanation: Verse 6 says to let their speech always be with grace, seasoned with salt, that they may know how they ought to answer each one.

answers.text: Few in words and slow to come
With grace, seasoned with salt
Plain, so that all may understand
Full of the sayings they were taught

questions.text: Who will make known all his affairs to them?
questions.explanation: Verse 7 says all his affairs will be made known to them by Tychicus, the beloved brother, faithful servant, and fellow bondservant in the Lord.

answers.text: Archippus
Demas
Tychicus
Justus

questions.text: Who is sent to them together with Tychicus?
questions.explanation: Verses 8 and 9 say he is sending him for this purpose, together with Onesimus, the faithful and beloved brother, who is one of them.

answers.text: Aristarchus
Nymphas
Timothy
Onesimus

questions.text: Whose cousin does verse 10 say Mark is?
questions.explanation: Verse 10 says Aristarchus, his fellow prisoner, greets them, and Mark, the cousin of Barnabas.

answers.text: Aristarchus
Barnabas
Epaphras
Luke

questions.text: For whom besides them does verse 13 say Epaphras has great zeal?
questions.explanation: Verse 13 testifies that Epaphras has great zeal for them, and for those in Laodicea, and for those in Hierapolis.

answers.text: Those in Laodicea and those in Hierapolis
Those in Macedonia and those in Achaia
Those in Philippi and those in Thessalonica
Those in Ephesus and those in Colossae

questions.text: How is Luke described in verse 14?
questions.explanation: Verse 14 says "Luke the beloved physician and Demas greet you."

answers.text: The faithful bondservant
The fellow prisoner
The beloved physician
The cousin of Barnabas

questions.text: What are they told to say to Archippus?
questions.explanation: Verse 17 says to tell Archippus to take heed to the ministry which he has received in the Lord, that he fulfill it.

answers.text: To carry this letter on to the assembly at Ephesus
To take heed to the ministry he received in the Lord, and fulfill it
To take the greetings of Luke and Demas to Hierapolis
To tell Nymphas to open his house to the brothers
